title: Polk County Commission, District 2
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Candidates from Ballot Brief / Who's Running snippets (https://theballotbrief.com/state/florida/polk-county); Quinn's party affiliation not stated in snippets. Official list https://www.polkelections.gov/31/Candidates not readable.

candidates.name: Rick Wilson
candidates.occupation: Cattle rancher and owner of family heavy-equipment business; Polk County commissioner since 2018; former NASCAR driver
candidates.background: Lifelong Bartow resident who works in cattle and agriculture; eight years on the commission. Endorsed by Sheriff Grady Judd (per snippet).

taxes.summary: In November 2023 he was part of the 4-1 majority that declined to put a proposed half-cent sales tax for roads (about $2.1 billion over 20 years) on the ballot. He says the county budget has very little fat and hard choices must be made on priorities.
taxes.quote: We currently operate with very little fat in our budget, so we would definitely have to roll our sleeves up and make hard decisions based on our priorities.

sources.title: Ethics complaint launched with accusations of private bargaining with fellow board members - Winter Haven Sun

environment.summary: In March 2022 he was one of three commissioners in a 3-2 vote to put the environmental lands property tax on the ballot; voters approved it, and he chairs the advisory committee that recommends land purchases under the program.
environment.quote: I am committed to responsible growth while at the same time being mindful of our need to protect our natural resources

growth.summary: Describes himself as supporting 'responsible growth' backed by infrastructure funding and a positive business climate. He notes most new homes are approved by cities, and cites his July 2022 vote to deny a 242-home subdivision in rural Kathleen as incompatible with the area.
growth.quote: I believe in responsible growth. Growth that is manageable and makes a positive impact on our county. Responsible growth means supporting infrastructure needs and funding for them.
